audit_status.source_base: Greek Acts text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Pentecost, Spirit/breath/fire/tongues, Peter's Joel/Psalm speech, turning/release, baptism, communal life.

verses.restored: When the day of Pentecost was being fulfilled, they were all together in the same place.

familiar.text: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

modern.text: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.

original.text: Καὶ ἐν τῷ συμπληροῦσθαι τὴν ἡμέραν τῆς πεντηκοστῆς ἦσαν ⸂πάντες ὁμοῦ⸃ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό,

verses.restored: Suddenly there came from heaven a sound like a violent rushing breath/wind, and it filled the whole house where they were sitting.

familiar.text: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

modern.text: Suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.

original.text: καὶ ἐγένετο ἄφνω ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἦχος ὥσπερ φερομένης πνοῆς βιαίας καὶ ἐπλήρωσεν ὅλον τὸν οἶκον οὗ ἦσαν καθήμενοι,

verses.restored: There appeared to them divided tongues as of fire, and it sat upon each one of them.

familiar.text: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.

modern.text: They saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.

original.text: καὶ ὤφθησαν αὐτοῖς διαμεριζόμεναι γλῶσσαι ὡσεὶ πυρός, ⸂καὶ ἐκάθισεν⸃ ἐφʼ ἕνα ἕκαστον αὐτῶν,

verses.restored: They were all filled with holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues, just as the Spirit was giving them to utter.

familiar.text: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

modern.text: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.

original.text: καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν ⸀πάντες πνεύματος ἁγίου, καὶ ἤρξαντο λαλεῖν ἑτέραις γλώσσαις καθὼς τὸ πνεῦμα ἐδίδου ⸂ἀποφθέγγεσθαι αὐτοῖς⸃.

verses.restored: Now there were Judeans dwelling in Jerusalem, devout people from every nation under heaven.

familiar.text: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

modern.text: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.

original.text: Ἦσαν δὲ ⸀ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ κατοικοῦντες Ἰουδαῖοι, ἄνδρες εὐλαβεῖς ἀπὸ παντὸς ἔθνους τῶν ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν·

verses.restored: When this sound happened, the multitude came together and was confused, because each one heard them speaking in one's own dialect.

familiar.text: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.

modern.text: And when this sound rang out, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard them speaking his own language.

original.text: γενομένης δὲ τῆς φωνῆς ταύτης συνῆλθε τὸ πλῆθος καὶ συνεχύθη, ὅτι ⸀ἤκουον εἷς ἕκαστος τῇ ἰδίᾳ διαλέκτῳ λαλούντων αὐτῶν·

verses.restored: They were amazed and marveling, saying, Look, are not all these speaking Galileans?

familiar.text: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?

modern.text: Astounded and amazed, they asked, “Are not all these men who are speaking Galileans?

original.text: ἐξίσταντο ⸀δὲ καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ⸀λέγοντες· ⸀Οὐχ ἰδοὺ ⸀πάντες οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ λαλοῦντες Γαλιλαῖοι;

verses.restored: How is it that we each hear in our own native dialect?

familiar.text: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?

modern.text: How is it then that each of us hears them in his own native language?

original.text: καὶ πῶς ἡμεῖς ἀκούομεν ἕκαστος τῇ ἰδίᾳ διαλέκτῳ ἡμῶν ἐν ᾗ ἐγεννήθημεν;

verses.restored: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, those dwelling in Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,

familiar.text: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

modern.text: Parthians, Medes, and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,

original.text: Πάρθοι καὶ Μῆδοι καὶ Ἐλαμῖται, καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν, Ἰουδαίαν τε καὶ Καππαδοκίαν, Πόντον καὶ τὴν Ἀσίαν,

verses.restored: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya toward Cyrene, and visiting Romans,

familiar.text: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,

modern.text: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome,

original.text: Φρυγίαν τε καὶ Παμφυλίαν, Αἴγυπτον καὶ τὰ μέρη τῆς Λιβύης τῆς κατὰ Κυρήνην, καὶ οἱ ἐπιδημοῦντες Ῥωμαῖοι,

verses.restored: both Judeans and proselytes, Cretans and Arabians, we hear them speaking in our tongues the great things of the Divine.

familiar.text: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.

modern.text: both Jews and converts to Judaism; Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!”

original.text: Ἰουδαῖοί τε καὶ προσήλυτοι, Κρῆτες καὶ Ἄραβες, ἀκούομεν λαλούντων αὐτῶν ταῖς ἡμετέραις γλώσσαις τὰ μεγαλεῖα τοῦ θεοῦ.

verses.restored: All were amazed and perplexed, saying to one another, What does this wish to be?

familiar.text: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

modern.text: Astounded and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”

original.text: ἐξίσταντο δὲ πάντες καὶ ⸀διηπόρουν, ἄλλος πρὸς ἄλλον λέγοντες· Τί ⸀θέλει τοῦτο εἶναι;

verses.restored: But others, mocking, were saying, They are filled with new wine.

familiar.text: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

modern.text: But others mocked them and said, “They are drunk on new wine!” Peter Addresses the Crowd (Psalms 16:1–11; Joel 2:28–32)

original.text: ἕτεροι δὲ ⸀διαχλευάζοντες ἔλεγον ὅτι Γλεύκους μεμεστωμένοι εἰσίν.

verses.restored: Peter, standing with the eleven, lifted his voice and declared to them, Men of Judea and all dwelling in Jerusalem, let this be known to you and listen to my words.

familiar.text: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

modern.text: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, lifted up his voice, and addressed the crowd: “Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen carefully to my words.

original.text: Σταθεὶς δὲ ⸀ὁ Πέτρος σὺν τοῖς ἕνδεκα ἐπῆρεν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπεφθέγξατο αὐτοῖς· Ἄνδρες Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Ἰερουσαλὴμ ⸀πάντες, τοῦτο ὑμῖν γνωστὸν ἔστω καὶ ἐνωτίσασθε τὰ ῥήματά μου.

verses.restored: For these are not drunk, as you suppose, for it is the third hour of the day.

familiar.text: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.

modern.text: These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It is only the third hour of the day!

original.text: οὐ γὰρ ὡς ὑμεῖς ὑπολαμβάνετε οὗτοι μεθύουσιν, ἔστιν γὰρ ὥρα τρίτη τῆς ἡμέρας,

verses.restored: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

familiar.text: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;

modern.text: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:

original.text: ἀλλὰ τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ εἰρημένον διὰ τοῦ προφήτου Ἰωήλ·

verses.restored: And it will be in the last days, says the Divine, I will pour out from my Spirit upon all flesh; your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young ones will see visions, and your elders will dream dreams.

familiar.text: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

modern.text: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.

original.text: Καὶ ἔσται ἐν ταῖς ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις, λέγει ὁ θεός, ἐκχεῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματός μου ἐπὶ πᾶσαν σάρκα, καὶ προφητεύσουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες ὑμῶν, καὶ οἱ νεανίσκοι ὑμῶν ὁράσεις ὄψονται, καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ὑμῶν ⸀ἐνυπνίοις ἐνυπνιασθήσονται·

verses.restored: Even upon my male servants and female servants in those days I will pour out from my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

familiar.text: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:

modern.text: Even on My menservants and maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.

original.text: καί γε ἐπὶ τοὺς δούλους μου καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς δούλας μου ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐκχεῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματός μου, καὶ προφητεύσουσιν.

verses.restored: I will give wonders in heaven above and signs on earth below, blood and fire and vapor of smoke.

familiar.text: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:

modern.text: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.

original.text: καὶ δώσω τέρατα ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἄνω καὶ σημεῖα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς κάτω, αἷμα καὶ πῦρ καὶ ἀτμίδα καπνοῦ·

verses.restored: The sun will be turned into darkness and the moon into blood before the great and manifest day of the Lord comes.

familiar.text: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:

modern.text: The sun will be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the coming of the great and glorious Day of the Lord.

original.text: ὁ ἥλιος μεταστραφήσεται εἰς σκότος καὶ ἡ σελήνη εἰς αἷμα πρὶν ⸀ἢ ⸀ἐλθεῖν ἡμέραν κυρίου τὴν μεγάλην καὶ ἐπιφανῆ.

verses.restored: And it will be that everyone who calls upon the name of the Lord will be saved/healed.

familiar.text: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

modern.text: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

original.text: καὶ ἔσται πᾶς ὃς ⸀ἐὰν ἐπικαλέσηται τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου σωθήσεται.

verses.restored: Men of Israel, hear these words: Jesus the Nazarene, a man attested to you by the Divine with powers, wonders, and signs that the Divine did through him in your midst, as you yourselves know—

familiar.text: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:

modern.text: Men of Israel, listen to this message: Jesus of Nazareth was a man certified by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs, which God did among you through Him, as you yourselves know.

original.text: Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται, ἀκούσατε τοὺς λόγους τούτους. Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον, ἄνδρα ⸂ἀποδεδειγμένον ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ⸃ εἰς ὑμᾶς δυνάμεσι καὶ τέρασι καὶ σημείοις οἷς ἐποίησεν διʼ αὐτοῦ ὁ θεὸς ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν, ⸀καθὼς αὐτοὶ οἴδατε,

verses.restored: this one, handed over by the determined plan and foreknowledge of the Divine, you fastened up through lawless hands and killed.

familiar.text: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

modern.text: He was delivered up by God’s set plan and foreknowledge, and you, by the hands of the lawless, put Him to death by nailing Him to the cross.

original.text: τοῦτον τῇ ὡρισμένῃ βουλῇ καὶ προγνώσει τοῦ θεοῦ ⸀ἔκδοτον διὰ ⸀χειρὸς ἀνόμων προσπήξαντες ἀνείλατε,

verses.restored: The Divine raised him up, loosening the pains of death, because it was not possible for him to be held by it.

familiar.text: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.

modern.text: But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for Him to be held in its clutches.

original.text: ὃν ὁ θεὸς ἀνέστησεν λύσας τὰς ὠδῖνας τοῦ θανάτου, καθότι οὐκ ἦν δυνατὸν κρατεῖσθαι αὐτὸν ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ·

verses.restored: For David says concerning him: I saw the Lord before me through all; because he is at my right hand, so that I may not be shaken.

familiar.text: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

modern.text: David says about Him: ‘I saw the Lord always before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

original.text: Δαυὶδ γὰρ λέγει εἰς αὐτόν· Προορώμην τὸν κύριον ἐνώπιόν μου διὰ παντός, ὅτι ἐκ δεξιῶν μού ἐστιν ἵνα μὴ σαλευθῶ.

verses.restored: Because of this my heart was glad and my tongue rejoiced; moreover my flesh will also dwell in hope.

familiar.text: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:

modern.text: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell in hope,

original.text: διὰ τοῦτο ηὐφράνθη ⸂ἡ καρδία μου⸃ καὶ ἠγαλλιάσατο ἡ γλῶσσά μου, ἔτι δὲ καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου κατασκηνώσει ἐπʼ ἐλπίδι·

verses.restored: Because you will not abandon my soul/life to Hades, nor give your Holy One to see decay.

familiar.text: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

modern.text: because You will not abandon my soul to Hades, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.

original.text: ὅτι οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψεις τὴν ψυχήν μου εἰς ⸀ᾅδην, οὐδὲ δώσεις τὸν ὅσιόν σου ἰδεῖν διαφθοράν.

verses.restored: You made known to me ways of life; you will fill me with gladness with your face.

familiar.text: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.

modern.text: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’

original.text: ἐγνώρισάς μοι ὁδοὺς ζωῆς, πληρώσεις με εὐφροσύνης μετὰ τοῦ προσώπου σου.

verses.restored: Men, siblings, it is permitted to speak with openness to you concerning the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is among us until this day.

familiar.text: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.

modern.text: Brothers, I can tell you with confidence that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

original.text: Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, ἐξὸν εἰπεῖν μετὰ παρρησίας πρὸς ὑμᾶς περὶ τοῦ πατριάρχου Δαυίδ, ὅτι καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν καὶ ἐτάφη, καὶ τὸ μνῆμα αὐτοῦ ἔστιν ἐν ἡμῖν ἄχρι τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης·

verses.restored: Being therefore a prophet, and knowing that the Divine had sworn with an oath to him to seat one from the fruit of his loins upon his throne,

familiar.text: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;

modern.text: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that He would place one of his descendants on his throne.

original.text: προφήτης οὖν ὑπάρχων, καὶ εἰδὼς ὅτι ὅρκῳ ὤμοσεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεὸς ἐκ καρποῦ τῆς ὀσφύος ⸀αὐτοῦ καθίσαι ἐπὶ ⸂τὸν θρόνον⸃ αὐτοῦ,

verses.restored: foreseeing, he spoke concerning the resurrection of the Messiah, that he was not abandoned to Hades, nor did his flesh see decay.

familiar.text: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.

modern.text: Foreseeing this, David spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that He was not abandoned to Hades, nor did His body see decay.

original.text: προϊδὼν ἐλάλησεν περὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως τοῦ χριστοῦ ὅτι ⸂οὔτε ἐγκατελείφθη⸃ εἰς ⸀ᾅδην ⸀οὔτε ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ εἶδεν διαφθοράν.

verses.restored: This Jesus the Divine raised up, of which we all are witnesses.

familiar.text: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

modern.text: God has raised this Jesus to life, to which we are all witnesses.

original.text: τοῦτον τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀνέστησεν ὁ θεός, οὗ πάντες ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν μάρτυρες.

verses.restored: Therefore being exalted to the right hand of the Divine, and having received from the Father the promise of the holy Spirit, he poured out this which you both see and hear.

familiar.text: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.

modern.text: Exalted, then, to the right hand of God, He has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.

original.text: τῇ δεξιᾷ οὖν τοῦ θεοῦ ὑψωθεὶς τήν τε ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ ⸂πνεύματος τοῦ ἁγίου⸃ λαβὼν παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ἐξέχεεν τοῦτο ⸀ὃ ⸀ὑμεῖς βλέπετε καὶ ἀκούετε.

verses.restored: For David did not ascend into the heavens, but he himself says: The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand,

familiar.text: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

modern.text: For David did not ascend into heaven, but he himself says: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand

original.text: οὐ γὰρ Δαυὶδ ἀνέβη εἰς τοὺς οὐρανούς, λέγει δὲ αὐτός· Εἶπεν ⸀ὁ κύριος τῷ κυρίῳ μου· Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου,

verses.restored: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.

familiar.text: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.

modern.text: until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’

original.text: ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου.

verses.restored: Let all the house of Israel therefore know securely that the Divine made him both Lord and Messiah, this Jesus whom you crucified.

familiar.text: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.

modern.text: Therefore let all Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ!” Three Thousand Believe

original.text: ἀσφαλῶς οὖν γινωσκέτω πᾶς οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ ὅτι καὶ κύριον ⸂αὐτὸν καὶ χριστὸν⸃ ⸂ἐποίησεν ὁ θεός⸃, τοῦτον τὸν Ἰησοῦν ὃν ὑμεῖς ἐσταυρώσατε.

verses.restored: Hearing this, they were pierced in the heart and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, Men, siblings, what should we do?

familiar.text: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?

modern.text: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and asked Peter and the other apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

original.text: Ἀκούσαντες δὲ κατενύγησαν ⸂τὴν καρδίαν⸃, εἶπόν τε πρὸς τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τοὺς λοιποὺς ἀποστόλους· Τί ⸀ποιήσωμεν, ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί;

verses.restored: Peter said to them, Turn/realign, and let each of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Messiah for release of your sins/misalignments, and you will receive the gift of the holy Spirit.

familiar.text: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

modern.text: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

original.text: Πέτρος δὲ ⸂πρὸς αὐτούς· Μετανοήσατε⸃, καὶ βαπτισθήτω ἕκαστος ὑμῶν ⸀ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς ἄφεσιν ⸀τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ⸀ὑμῶν, καὶ λήμψεσθε τὴν δωρεὰν τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος·

verses.restored: For the promise is to you and to your children and to all those far away, as many as the Lord our Divine may call.

familiar.text: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the LORD our God shall call.

modern.text: This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off—to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.”

original.text: ὑμῖν γάρ ἐστιν ἡ ἐπαγγελία καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις ὑμῶν καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς εἰς μακρὰν ὅσους ἂν προσκαλέσηται κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν.

verses.restored: With many other words he bore witness and urged them, saying, Be saved/healed from this crooked generation.

familiar.text: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.

modern.text: With many other words he testified, and he urged them, “Be saved from this corrupt generation.”

original.text: ἑτέροις τε λόγοις πλείοσιν διεμαρτύρατο, καὶ παρεκάλει ⸀αὐτοὺς λέγων· Σώθητε ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς τῆς σκολιᾶς ταύτης.

verses.restored: Therefore those receiving his word were baptized, and about three thousand souls/lives were added that day.

familiar.text: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.

modern.text: Those who embraced his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to the believers that day. The Fellowship of Believers (Acts 4:32–37)

original.text: οἱ μὲν ⸀οὖν ἀποδεξάμενοι τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ ἐβαπτίσθησαν, καὶ προσετέθησαν ⸀ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ψυχαὶ ὡσεὶ τρισχίλιαι.

verses.restored: They were persevering in the teaching of the apostles and the fellowship, the breaking of bread and the prayers.

familiar.text: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

modern.text: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.

original.text: ἦσαν δὲ προσκαρτεροῦντες τῇ διδαχῇ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ τῇ ⸀κοινωνίᾳ, τῇ κλάσει τοῦ ἄρτου καὶ ταῖς προσευχαῖς.

verses.restored: Awe came upon every soul/life, and many wonders and signs were happening through the apostles.

familiar.text: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.

modern.text: A sense of awe came over everyone, and the apostles performed many wonders and signs.

original.text: ⸀Ἐγίνετο δὲ πάσῃ ψυχῇ φόβος, πολλά ⸀τε τέρατα καὶ σημεῖα διὰ τῶν ἀποστόλων ἐγίνετο.

verses.restored: All those trusting were together and had all things common.

familiar.text: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

modern.text: All the believers were together and had everything in common.

original.text: πάντες δὲ οἱ ⸀πιστεύοντες ⸂ἦσαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ⸃ εἶχον ἅπαντα κοινά,

verses.restored: They were selling possessions and goods and distributing them to all, as anyone had need.

familiar.text: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.

modern.text: Selling their possessions and goods, they shared with anyone who was in need.

original.text: καὶ τὰ κτήματα καὶ τὰς ὑπάρξεις ἐπίπρασκον καὶ διεμέριζον αὐτὰ πᾶσιν καθότι ἄν τις χρείαν εἶχεν·

verses.restored: Day by day, persevering with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread house by house, they shared food with gladness and simplicity of heart,

familiar.text: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,

modern.text: With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house, sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart,

original.text: καθʼ ἡμέραν τε προσκαρτεροῦντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ, κλῶντές τε κατʼ οἶκον ἄρτον, μετελάμβανον τροφῆς ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει καὶ ἀφελότητι καρδίας,

verses.restored: praising the Divine and having favor with all the people. And the Lord was adding day by day those being saved/healed together.

familiar.text: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

modern.text: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.

original.text: αἰνοῦντες τὸν θεὸν καὶ ἔχοντες χάριν πρὸς ὅλον τὸν λαόν. ὁ δὲ κύριος προσετίθει τοὺς σῳζομένους καθʼ ἡμέραν ⸂ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό⸃.
